fields.description: Program Description Program Introduction Editor Notes: This program enables students with 0 Chinese language knowledge to learn Chinese program in the first year and then degree programs in DMU directly. 1. Pakistani students who apply for the 1+5 program can apply through CUCAS Pakistan Add: Hest Building Sabzarar Metro Station Bosan Road Multan, Phone number: 00923001330187, Dalian Medical University will check students' information and application documents, those who meet the admission requirements of the program will get scan copy of admission letter from Dalian Medical University first. 2. Students who were accepted by the program will then study the preparatory program in Dalian Medical University for the first year. 3. Those who got HSK 4 certificate with enough scores and passed related tests will enter bachelor degree(5 years) in Dalian Medical University for the following years. Clinical Medicine program is taught in Chinese. Tuition fee is 15000 RMB for the first year preparatory program and 25000 RMB/year for degree program, which is exclusive for CUCAS students. Accommodation fee for this project is about 5000 RMB/year, quad room, no private bath room. Note: The course requires students to pay the tuition or admission deposit before issuing the admission package. Admission Plan: 30 to 60 seats.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Physical Examination Form(only valid for 6 months) Please take it to hospital to have a checkup with all items, including personal information, photo, checking date, doctors' suggestion and signature. * 2. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included(Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Passport must be an ordinary passport and be valid for at least six months from the application time until September 30, 2019. Applicants currently residing in China must include a copy of the page containing a valid visa or residence permit.) * 3. Notarized highest degree graduation certificate, and then get the notarized copy certified by local Chinese embassy or consulate. For students from countries joined Hague Conventions could provide apostille documents. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English need to be translated into Chinese during notarization, and make sure you bring all original application documents including these to China during registration. * 4. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 5. Notarized highest degree transcripts, and then get the notarized copy certified by local Chinese embassy or consulate. 1.Transcripts that are not in Chinese or English must be translated into Chinese and then notarized. 2.After notarization, they must also be authenticated by the local Chinese embassy or consulate (for countries that are part of the Hague Convention, an Apostille is required). 3.You must bring the original transcripts, as well as the original notarization and authentication documents, when reporting for registration. Otherwise, you will not be able to complete the registration. * 6. Financial support statement Photocopy of the financial support statement with signature 7. Other materials If you are underage (over 17 years old, but not reach 18 when school starts), you should submit the Guardian letter which should be attested by the Chinese embassy in your country. 8. Supporting Documents: Certificate of Good Conduct Provided by your current/previous school/company in Chinese/English to improve your success rate. You can download a template or sample from here . * 9. Students should sign a letter of undertaking * 10. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -Mathematics and Chemistry test results are required. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements The applicant should be above 18 years old,mental and physical healthy,has completed the senior high school course with good marks(above 60%),has solid financial support to afford the study and living expenses in China.Chemistry,physics,biology,English are compulsory subjects,maths is a reference subject for admission.
